# Overview
This notebook focuses on model training and evaluation in R.

# Packages
```{r}
# install.packages("tidymodels") # run once if needed
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
```

# Data
```{r}
# Replace with your processed dataset path
data_path <- "../data/processed/diabetes_clean.csv"

# Choose your target column
# "Diabetes_binary" for binary dataset, or "Diabetes_012" for 0/1/2 dataset

target_col <- "Diabetes_binary"

df <- readr::read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(target = all_of(target_col))

glimpse(df)
```

# Train/Test Split
```{r}
set.seed(42)

split <- initial_split(df, prop = 0.8, strata = target)
train_data <- training(split)
test_data <- testing(split)
```

# Recipe
```{r}
rec <- recipe(target ~ ., data = train_data) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
```

# Model
```{r}
# For multiclass (Diabetes_012), consider multinom_reg() or xgboost
model <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm") %>%
  set_mode("classification")
```

# Workflow and Fit
```{r}
wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec) %>%
  add_model(model)

fit <- fit(wf, data = train_data)
```

# Evaluation
```{r}
preds <- predict(fit, test_data, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(fit, test_data, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data %>% select(target))

metrics(preds, truth = target, estimate = .pred_class)
conf_mat(preds, truth = target, estimate = .pred_class)
```

# Save Model
```{r}
dir.create("../models", showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(fit, "../models/log_reg.rds")
```

sessionInfo()
